dct_description_sm: Permafrost degradation is a major concern related to global change in the Arctic and carbon budget. Thermo-erosion gullies are rapid and wide permafrost degradation landforms that need to be understood as they strongly modify the Arctic terrestrial landscape (carbon exportations, drainage of wet polygons, change in food resources for local fauna, infrastructures perturbations). The presence of ice-rich soils in continuous permafrost landscapes is determinant in the mechanisms leading thermo-erosion. In order to get a better understanding of this permafrost perturbation, gullies formed in distinct sedimentary composition were measured and analyzed.
dct_title_s: Characterization of thermo-erosion gullies developed in continuous permafrost environment, Bylot Island, Nunavut
